headline: 紀錄片與新專輯短評
context: 先看紀錄片：Channel 4新紀錄片《Tommy Robinson: Where's the Money Gone?》，追問英國極右翼團體「英格蘭防衛聯盟」共同創辦人湯米·羅賓森（Tommy Robinson，本名Stephen Yaxley-Lennon）的募款流向，片中提到他曾在兩週內就向支持者募得35萬英鎊。再看音樂：英國獨立搖滾樂團The Tubs發行第三張專輯《Hard Life》，延續復古吉他搖滾路線。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: From his claim of being ‘de-banked’ to a disturbing detail about a rape survivor’s story being used to fundraise, this film puts big questions to the co-founder of the English Defence League. But it is frustratingly hard to get answers You can’t say it would be a huge surprise if a leading figure of the British far right turned out to be a fraudster: that whole strand of politics is, after all, a con job preying on angry citizens who are daft enough to believe that immigrants, and not the rapaciously greedy super-rich, are somehow the cause of the nation’s problems. If people will fall for that, fleecing them out of their money is not a big leap. Tommy Robinson, co-founder of the English Defence League and now an influencer, independent documentary-maker and international flag-shaggers’ guru, was convicted of mortgage fraud in 2014, but what about 2026? Is he a scam artist juicing idiots for cash? Robinson, real name Stephen Christopher Yaxley-Lennon, is undeniably a talented harvester of donations from his fans, whether it’s in person at his rallies or via the internet: in a video posted online, he admits to “continually ask[ing] you, the people, to support us”, and in another he boasts of having once convinced his admirers to hand over £350,000 in the space of two weeks. If you try to avoid seeing or hearing about Robinson, the amount of money he generates may shock you. Tommy Robinson: Where’s the Money Gone? is on Channel 4 now. Continue reading...

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: (Merge) Britain’s best indie-rockers hold fast to their defiantly old-school sound, slipping wry sideways looks at despair in among hooky melodies that always sound like a good time On a track called Heaven or London from the Tubs’ third album, the quartet’s frontman, Owen Williams, offers a blunt self-assessment. He is, he suggests, “the singer of a rip-off band”, engaged in “wanking himself into an early grave”. It’s a strange thing to say given that the Tubs have recently become a critical cause célèbre. Their last album, Cotton Crown , was a regular fixture in best of 2025 lists. They have been unexpectedly clasped to the bosom of the heritage rock press and had a profile in the New Yorker, which called them a “British jangle-rock band, with a cheeky dirtbag edge”. That they’ve achieved this not by pandering to the dictates of musical fashion but by ploughing their own furrow makes it even more impressive. Much has been made of Williams’s vocal resemblance to folk-rock legend Richard Thompson, and you can understand why. But what the Tubs really sound like is old-school, pre-Madchester indie rock. Distorted guitars do battle with trebly acoustic or 12-string guitar, the punky heft and wistful melodies evocative of Hüsker Dü or the Replacements in their poppier, post-hardcore years. You could also throw pre-stadium REM into the mix: the most plangent of the lead guitar lines on Hard Life have a ring of Peter Buck about them, such as the lovely figures that spin around If You Don’t Love Me, and the arpeggio that drives In Your Place along for five and half minutes. The album comes liberally decorated with violin, which recalls Amanda Brown’s contributions to the Go-Betweens’ late-80s albums. Continue reading...

thread_text:
紀錄片與新專輯短評

先看紀錄片。Channel 4新紀錄片《Tommy Robinson: Where's the Money Gone?》，追問英國極右翼團體「英格蘭防衛聯盟」共同創辦人湯米·羅賓森（Tommy Robinson，本名Stephen Yaxley-Lennon）的募款流向，片中提到他曾在兩週內就向支持者募得35 萬英鎊。羅賓森2014年曾因房貸詐欺被定罪。

再看音樂。英國獨立搖滾樂團The Tubs發行第三張專輯《Hard Life》，延續復古吉他搖滾路線，樂評形容他們的曲風介於Hüsker Dü與R.E.M.之間。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 9 月 11 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
紀錄片與新專輯短評

先看紀錄片。Channel 4新紀錄片《Tommy Robinson: Where's the Money Gone?》，把鏡頭對準英國極右翼團體「英格蘭防衛聯盟」共同創辦人湯米·羅賓森（Tommy Robinson，本名Stephen Yaxley-Lennon），追問他這些年募款來的錢究竟去了哪裡。片中提到，他曾在一支影片裡自曝，兩週內就向支持者募得35 萬英鎊，也被人指控曾利用一名性侵倖存者的故事募款。羅賓森2014年曾因房貸詐欺被定罪，但片子最終沒能問出明確答案。

再看音樂。英國獨立搖滾樂團The Tubs發行第三張專輯《Hard Life》，延續他們一貫的復古吉他搖滾路線。樂評形容，這張專輯的曲風介於Hüsker Dü與R.E.M.早期作品之間，主唱歐文·威廉斯（Owen Williams）在其中一首歌裡，還自嘲自己是「翻版樂團的主唱」。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 9 月 11 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 先看一部紀錄片。英國Channel 4的新片，把鏡頭對準極右翼團體「英格蘭防衛聯盟」的共同創辦人，追問他這些年募款來的錢究竟去了哪裡。片中提到，他曾在兩週內就向支持者募得35 萬英鎊，也被指控利用一名性侵倖存者的故事募款。他2014年曾因房貸詐欺被定罪，但這部片最終沒能問出明確答案。換個話題，聊聊音樂。英國獨立搖滾樂團The Tubs發行第三張專輯，延續一貫的復古吉他搖滾路線，樂評形容這張專輯的曲風，介於幾支美式另類搖滾天團之間。
